risk_note: RV2 by path (the PR carries rule tests). Admin step-up dialog (totp / sms tiers per the AdmStepUp / AdmStepUpSms boards), single six-digit OtpInput, StepUpGate (sms tier without a registered verify phone stays focusable with aria-disabled and the error.10003.verify_phone_missing text); title focus, Tab cycle, background inert with original values restored, focus returned after the commit; 20002 / 20003 / 42901 handling with Retry-After (default 5 s), send-round counting, monotonic deadlines, stale results dropped after close, missing token treated as failure. Rule tests by Codex (two writes, red first in the container), implementation by Opus 5.5 (three rounds plus one extra round granted by the owner on 2026-10-07, blocked B-10 option A). Written by hand.
